title: Literature Sources Validation Schema
description: Validation schema for records in the literature_sources tab of the Concrete Grand Challenge Experimental Database submission template.

source_id.description: Unique identifier of the source document, dataset, report, thesis, or experimental campaign.

source_type.description: Type of source. Must correspond to an entry in the controlled vocabulary source_types.json.

peer_reviewed.description: Indicates whether the source was peer reviewed.

authors.description: Author list as reported in the source. Multiple authors should be comma-separated.

journal_or_publisher.description: Journal name, publisher, report agency, hosting institution, or conference proceedings.

url.description: URL to the source or dataset record.

institution.description: Institution associated with a report, thesis, dataset, or experimental campaign.

notes.description: Additional notes useful for identifying the source.
